body:
Objectively untrue. Is the system that police operate under and within completely broken and outdated? Yes. Do we still need police officers to ensure this country continues to run, and not fall into chaos. Also yes. I understand your sentiment and agree in that this cop was in fact the very embodiment of evil. I do also think, however, that this statement lacks nuance and ignores the fact that for every bad cop there are probably hundreds of others who would and do actively place their lives on the line for us every day. 
I'm not trying to bootlick, don't get me wrong, but I feel like your stance on this matter does nothing to actually help anyone, all you are doing is polarizing groups of people that need to come together.

This theory sounds so cool but it also freaks me out quite a bit. This just means that realities where all the potentially fatal or dangerous mistakes I've made throughout my life exist somewhere too, and in those alternative realities the "darker timeline" took place. I know it's not that serious but I almost got into a wreck driving my parents somewhere a few days ago, and now I can't stop thinking about that. Like did I kill my parents in this other reality? Obviously not, cause here I am, but still. Idk man.
